aggregation.checkpoint_task_metric: mean across selected states, with states equally weighted
aggregation.checkpoint_task_performance: mean native success over the 15 common resets
aggregation.competitive_subset: optimizer step 100 only, one checkpoint per development lineage
aggregation.gate_concordance: equal-task macro-average cross-lineage checkpoint-pair concordance; performance ties excluded and predictor ties score 0.5
aggregation.nested_stages: both retained as repeated measures inside a whole-seed lineage; same-lineage checkpoint pairs excluded
aggregation.selection_regret: empirical best task success minus empirical success of the metric-selected checkpoint
aggregation.task_centered_rank: Spearman and Kendall tau-b between success centered within task and negative metric centered within task
aggregation.top_k: top-1 and top-3 overlap per task; empirical success ties included

bootstrap.resampling: tasks and whole lineages sampled with replacement; whole demos sampled within task; common resets sampled within task; both nested stages remain in each sampled lineage occurrence

branch_panel.infrastructure_retry: one identical retry only when no valid materialized score exists

performance_identifiability.distinguishable_rule: hierarchical paired 95% bootstrap interval for empirical best-minus-worst macro success is strictly above zero
performance_identifiability.three_band_rule: all three fixed macro-success bands contain at least one checkpoint

selected_assay.continuation: registered expert actions t+1 through t+4; the splice step plus four continuations are scored
selected_assay.score: candidate bounded recovery cost minus independent nominal bounded recovery cost

stage0_gate.cost_denominator: 16 checkpoints * 15 resets * sum of official suite step caps
stage0_gate.cost_numerator: all nominal, paired-candidate, and unpaired-candidate prefix plus scored simulator control steps; absorbing scored steps are also reported
stage0_gate.negative_control_reproduction: a control reproduces the gain only if concordance >=0.60, gain over normalized MSE >=0.08, and grouped-bootstrap P(gain>0) >=0.90
stage0_gate.non_domination: pass unless every available strong equal-input baseline exceeds ICAE concordance by at least 0.02
